text:
No one tells us how

to turn our face to the wall

and

die simply,

as the cat did

or the dog of the house

or the elephant

that walked after its agony

like someone going

to an unpostponable ceremony,

flapping its ears

to the rhythm

of the cadenced breathing

of its trunk.

only in the animal kingdom

are there examples of such

behavior:

change step,

draw near

and smell what has already been lived,

and turn around,

simply

turn around.

translation.title: No One Tells Us
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the elephant's ceremonial walk and the simple final turn.
